rationale: The original short thesis relied on overhead resistance at session VWAP ($197.45) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($197.98) holding, but price has reclaimed both levels on rising 1-minute volume and is making higher lows. With the broader market strongly bullish (SPY +0.96%) and the position losing its technical resistance structure after giving back a 1.45% favorable excursion, closing now cuts the trade before a full stop-out at $199.50. A flip to long is avoided due to the wide 22.2 bps spread and substantial overhead supply from the opening selloff.
